scope: 6 editorial text units covering Discipline Ability Tree title and the 5 Discipline tree names. Discipline card titles and margin website link remain as source artwork.

verification.viewer: Official source PDF, current EN print, and PT-BR print/viewer artifacts from 2026-11-18 compared. Six title/discipline units render once; no visible clipping or displacement.
verification.editor: Six text units remain editable; rich styles, frame IDs, artwork, and discipline names are preserved; no blocks created.
verification.pdf: Existing same-day PT-BR and EN page PDFs were inspected against the official PDF source. A second fresh export attempt timed out waiting for .page-container; see currentStateAudit in the ability-names proposal.
verification.humanEditorialApproval: Six units have active approved official Reviewer records; this does not claim human editorial approval. The complete page retains nine open terminology decisions among the ability-name units.

copyfitMeasurement.method: scripts/measure_copyfit_page.mjs: PyMuPDF text spans grouped by actual span baseline (1 pt tolerance), so one visual row split around an inline object remains one row even when per-run bbox centres differ; live PT-BR PageRenderer text rects plus visible semantic-symbol rects for symbol-only rows are clustered by vertical centre (0.5 x median rect height). Inline symbols overlapping a text row are counted with that row, not as extra lines. Candidate text and symbol IDs must match the selected renderer unit. No character count, string newline count or frame-height estimate was used.
